result.rationale: Verified in the diff: the controller defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but embedding.hbs contains only the Add Host button (no save button bound to saveChanges), and the server-side `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` merely re-renders the serializer without persisting anything. This is dead/no-op code, not a behavioral defect, but it is a specific, grounded concern: a future maintainer wiring a save button to saveChanges would silently persist nothing.
